name: BAMBULE
reason: Contradictory twice over. The visible block says Montag–Freitag 10:00–22:30 and Samstag/Sonntag 09:00–21:00/21:30 — itself two closing times for one row — while the schema.org openingHours says Mo–Fr 10:00–23:00 and Sa/Su 09:00–22:00.

name: Bloc-Hütte Augsburg
reason: The site states two different schedules. Every page shows Montag 13.00–22.30 … Sonntag 09.00–21.00 in its text, while the schema.org node for the gym itself (ExerciseGym #organization) carries openingHours "Monday,…,Sunday 09:00-17:00". Two official statements by the same venue disagree, so nothing is published.

name: Boulderhalle Beta Hannover
reason: Same conflict as Bloc-Hütte Augsburg: the text says Mo–Fr 10:00–23:00 and Sa/So/Feiertag 09:00–22:00 on every page, while the site's schema.org openingHours says "Monday,…,Sunday 09:00-17:00". Two official statements, no way to rank them.

name: DAV Taufkirchen (Vils)
reason: Wix site whose navigation is script-driven: the homepage fetches as readable text but carries no schedule, and no subpage can be reached without executing the page. Worth re-reading with something that renders.

name: Hold On Tide
reason: The published week is explicitly headed "Öffnungszeiten außerhalb der Ferien" and a different holiday-period schedule is published beside it (opening at 13:00 Mo, Mi–Fr). Which one applies depends on the school-holiday calendar, so neither is a regular week this overlay can carry.

name: Kletterarena
reason: The only schedule on the page is "Ab 13.07.2026 geänderte Sommer-Öffnungszeiten" (Mo–Fr 08:00–13:00 and 15:00–23:00, Sa/So 08:00–20:00) with no end date and no regular week beside it. Publishing it would publish a temporary schedule that reverts without notice.

name: Kraftwerk Lüneburg
reason: Two published regimes: Sommer (01.07.–30.09.) Mo–Fr 14:30–22:30 and Winter (01.10.–30.06.) Mo–Fr 13:00–22:30, weekends 11:00–21:00 in both. A single weekly grid would be wrong for nine months or for three, and this overlay has no way to expire one.

name: Mandala Boulderhalle Dresden
reason: The operator runs two Dresden halls (Zeitenströmung and Postplatz) and publishes one Preise & Öffnungszeiten page (Mo–Fr 8–23, Sa/So/Feiertage 9–22) that never says which of them it applies to. The Zeitenströmung location page itself prints no schedule.

name: TeisendorfMoon
reason: The page states Montag bis Sonntag 07:00–22:00 and then qualifies it away: reservation is compulsory whenever the school may use the hall (Mo–Do 8:00–15:30, Fr 8:00–13:00), club training closes it at unlisted times, and it cannot be used at all while the Turnhalle is shut in the holidays. There is no regular week left to publish.
